ebay:267766751444.description:
LEONARD FREED – WORLDVIEW

A beautiful first edition, 2007 hardback of Worldview by the acclaimed American photographer Leonard Freed, published by Steidl and printed in Germany.

Leonard Freed was an important figure in twentieth-century documentary photography and a member of the renowned Magnum Photos agency. His work is recognised for its powerful, human and often quietly observational approach to everyday life, society and the world around him.

Worldview brings together Freed’s compelling photography in a beautifully produced Steidl volume. His images offer a fascinating perspective on people, places and social life, combining documentary observation with a distinctive artistic sensibility.

This is an especially attractive edition for anyone interested in documentary photography, photojournalism, Magnum photographers and twentieth-century photographic books.

BOOK DETAILS

* Title: Worldview
* Photographer/Author: Leonard Freed
* Publisher: Steidl
* Publication: 2007
* Edition: First Edition
* Format: Hardback
* Printed in: Germany

COLLECTABLE PHOTOGRAPHY BOOK

A fine example of Steidl’s renowned book production and an excellent opportunity to add a first-edition Leonard Freed title to a photography collection.

Leonard Freed’s work is held in major photographic collections and his books are sought after by collectors of documentary and fine-art photography.
